libs.note: BH-7597 (slice C0): the client half of the saved browser session of a web-task run (worker/jobs/src/routes/web-session.js). wsess_save and wsess_load POST to the worker; these two are the box-side HTTP timeouts of those calls. Applied by the lib through lib_env_apply web-session when the caller has loaded bin/lib/lane-gate.sh. Doc: docs/notes/2026-11-01-BH-7597-web-session.md.

knobs.note: The whole-request timeout of each worker call of wsess_save and wsess_load (curl -m). Read as ${WEB_SESSION_TIMEOUT_S:-15}.
The connect timeout of the same calls (curl --connect-timeout). Read as ${WEB_SESSION_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_S:-5}.
